title: "tab_declassant_shiny"
output: html_document
---

# Chargement des packages
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(ggtext)
library(ggalluvial)
library(shiny)
library(gt)
```

# Chargement des données

```{r}
table_element_declassant <- readRDS(here("Data/clean_data", "table_element_declassant.rds"))
```

# Associer le code couleur des classes d'état 
```{r}
classe_libelle <- c("Mauvais", "Médiocre", "Moyen", "Bon", "Très bon")
couleurs <- c("red", "orange", "yellow", "lightgreen", "#2b83ba")

names(couleurs) <- classe_libelle
```

# Génerer une tableau au format shiny
```{r message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
ui <- fluidPage(
  
  titlePanel("État biologique des stations"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      width = 3,
      
      # --- Filtres ---
      selectInput("dep", "Département :", 
                  choices = c("Tous", sort(unique(table_element_declassant$code_departement)))),
      selectInput("reseau", "Réseau :", choices = "Tous"),
      selectInput("station", "Station :", choices = "Tous"),
      selectInput("annee", "Année :", choices = "Tous"),
      
      tags$hr(),
      
      # --- Légende des couleurs ---
      tags$h4("Légende des classes"),
      div(style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px;",
          
          lapply(names(couleurs), function(nom) {
            div(
              style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;",
              div(style=sprintf(
                "width:20px; height:20px; background:%s; border-radius:3px;",
                couleurs[nom]
              )),
              nom
            )
          })
      )
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      width = 9,
      gt_output("table_gt")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  # --- Données préparées ---
  tab2 <- table_element_declassant %>%
    mutate(
      etat_biologique = as.character(etat_biologique),
      element_declassant = sapply(element_declassant, function(x) paste(x, collapse = ", "))
    ) %>%
    select(code_departement, reseaux, libelle_station, annee,
           IBD, IBMR, I2M2, IPR, etat_biologique, element_declassant) %>%
    arrange(code_departement, libelle_station, annee)
  
  # --- Mise à jour dynamique des filtres ---
  
  # 1) Quand le département change → mettre à jour réseau, station, année
  observeEvent(input$dep, {
    df <- tab2 %>% filter(code_departement == input$dep | input$dep == "Tous")
    
    updateSelectInput(session, "reseau",
                      choices = c("Tous", sort(unique(df$reseaux))),
                      selected = "Tous")
    
    updateSelectInput(session, "station",
                      choices = c("Tous", sort(unique(df$libelle_station))),
                      selected = "Tous")
    
    updateSelectInput(session, "annee",
                      choices = c("Tous", sort(unique(df$annee))),
                      selected = "Tous")
  })
  
  # 2) Quand réseau change → mettre à jour station + année
  observeEvent(input$reseau, {
    df <- tab2 %>%
      filter((code_departement == input$dep | input$dep == "Tous") &
             (reseaux == input$reseau | input$reseau == "Tous"))
    
    updateSelectInput(session, "station",
                      choices = c("Tous", sort(unique(df$libelle_station))),
                      selected = "Tous")
    
    updateSelectInput(session, "annee",
                      choices = c("Tous", sort(unique(df$annee))),
                      selected = "Tous")
  })
  
  # 3) Quand station change → mettre à jour année
  observeEvent(input$station, {
    df <- tab2 %>%
      filter((code_departement == input$dep | input$dep == "Tous") &
             (reseaux == input$reseau | input$reseau == "Tous") &
             (libelle_station == input$station | input$station == "Tous"))
    
    updateSelectInput(session, "annee",
                      choices = c("Tous", sort(unique(df$annee))),
                      selected = "Tous")
  })
  
  # --- Filtrage final des données ---
  data_filtered <- reactive({
    df <- tab2
    
    if (input$dep != "Tous") df <- df %>% filter(code_departement == input$dep)
    if (input$reseau != "Tous") df <- df %>% filter(reseaux == input$reseau)
    if (input$station != "Tous") df <- df %>% filter(libelle_station == input$station)
    if (input$annee != "Tous") df <- df %>% filter(annee == input$annee)
    
    df
  })
  
  # --- Tableau GT identique ---
  output$table_gt <- render_gt({
    
    df <- data_filtered()
    
    df %>%
      mutate(code_departement=paste("Département ", code_departement),
         reseaux=paste("Réseau ", reseaux)) %>% 
      group_by(code_departement, reseaux) %>% 
      gt() %>% 
      cols_hide(columns = c(code_departement, reseaux)) %>% 
      tab_options(table.width = pct(70),
                  table.font.size = px(13)) %>% 
      tab_style(style = list(cell_text(indent = px(20)), 
                             cell_borders(
                               sides = "all",
                               color = "#f7f7f7",
                               weight = px(2))), 
                locations = cells_body()) %>% 
      tab_style(
        style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold", size = px(14)), cell_fill(color = "#f7f7f7")),
        locations = cells_row_groups()
      ) %>% 
      tab_style(
        style = cell_text(size = px(14), weight = "bold"),
        locations = cells_column_labels()) %>% 
      opt_row_striping() %>% 
      cols_label(
        libelle_station = "Station",
        etat_biologique = "Etat biologique",
        reseaux = "Réseau",
        annee = "Année",
        element_declassant="Elément déclassant"
      ) %>%
      tab_header(
        title = md("**Classe d'état biologique des 4 indices, par station et par année, et classe d'état biologique retenue pour la DCE.**"),
        subtitle = md("La variable **Etat biologique** contient le nom de l'élément déclassant.")
      ) %>% 
      sub_missing(columns = c("IBD", "IBMR", "IPR", "I2M2")) %>%
      data_color(columns = c("IBD", "IBMR", "I2M2", "IPR"),
                 fn = function(x) ifelse(x %in% classe_libelle, couleurs[x], "transparent")) %>%
      data_color(columns = "etat_biologique",
                 fn = function(x) ifelse(x %in% classe_libelle, couleurs[x], "transparent")) %>%
      text_transform(
        locations = cells_body(columns = "etat_biologique"),
        fn = function(x) ""
      ) %>%
      text_transform(
        locations = cells_body(columns = c("IBD","IBMR","IPR","I2M2")),
        fn = function(x) ""
      ) %>%
      cols_width(
        c(IBD, IBMR, I2M2, IPR) ~ px(60),
        etat_biologique ~ px(80),
        element_declassant ~ px(140),
        annee ~px(60),
        libelle_station ~px(280)
      ) %>%
      cols_align(align = "center", columns = c("etat_biologique","element_declassant", "annee"))
  })
}


shinyApp(ui, server)
```
